question: Where is the nearest gallery along the corridor from University Spine Center, Wayne, NJ to NYU Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, New York, NY?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%University Spine Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%NYU Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), corridor_path AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(s.geometry, e.geometry)::geography, 1000)::geometry AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%gallery%' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM corridor_path)::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
